reason: The photo is filled with coffee beans edge to edge, but the mask stops about 30–50 px short of every edge. That leaves strips of beans outside on the left, top, right and bottom, plus a notch at the right edge near y≈0.83. Together these strips are several beans' worth of area. The two small circular holes are minor and don't affect the verdict.

The beans fill the whole photo. The mask covers almost all of it and only leaves out a thin strip, about 35 px wide and much narrower than one bean, along the edges. Everything inside is beans, with no tray, rim, table or hand. The two small circular holes and the small notch at the lower right are smaller than a bean and don't trace individual beans.

The photo is entirely filled with green coffee beans, and the mask covers 99.7% of it. The boundary only runs along the photo edge, with tiny notches and one small hole in a dark gap between beans. No tray, rim or table is inside the mask, and no bean pile is left outside it.

On the left, between about y=25% and y=75% of the photo, the outline juts out to the photo's left edge. It takes in a wide strip of dark tray and table with no beans (T2, left part of the overview). The rest of the outline follows the beans and the tray edge acceptably.

The whole photo is filled with coffee beans. The mask's outline is a straight diagonal line from the bottom-left to the top-right, and it cuts through beans (T3, T4, T5). The lower-right part of the pile, about 40% of the photo, is left outside. Small holes and ragged edges also show up at the left and top edges.

A diagonal straight line cuts across the pile from the left edge to the bottom, so the whole lower-left part of the bean pile (beans in T3 and the area to the left and below the line) is left outside the mask. The upper and right boundaries follow the pile edge well.

The top edge of the outline has a rectangular bulge, about x=447–990 and y=349–403 in the overview. It covers the dark inner back wall of the tray above the beans (T1, T6), so tray is inside the mask. The rest of the boundary follows the bean pile closely.

The whole photo is filled with coffee beans, but the mask's top edge runs at about 11% of the image height. A full-width strip of beans above it is left outside, far more than one bean's worth. There is also a thin uncovered strip along the left edge and the bottom.
